MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

3. Solve for x: x + 5 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 5

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

5. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 12
   C. 2
   D. 10

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

8. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

9. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 12
   D. 13

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

12. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

13. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

14. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

15. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
